_comment: BIDDING SCHEDULE CONFIGURATION - Edit this file to change when the weekly auction runs

timezone._description: Timezone settings for the auction schedule
timezone.name: GMT+8 (Manila Time)
timezone._note: offsetHours: Number of hours offset from UTC (8 for Manila/GMT+8)

auction._description: Main auction schedule - when the weekly auction starts

_instructions.dayName: Update this to match the day you selected (for logging/display purposes only)

preAuctionSync._description: Pre-auction sync settings - syncs bidding points from Google Sheets to MongoDB before auction

_instructions.hoursBeforeAuction: How many hours before the auction to sync data (recommended: 1)

announcement._description: Announcement settings - sends warning to Discord before auction starts

_instructions.leadTimeMinutes: How many minutes before auction to send announcement (recommended: 15)

exampleSchedules._note: Examples to help you set up different schedules
